description: Small public criterion set for API judge smoke tests and examples. Full paper reruns may supply experiment-specific rubrics.

criteria.criterion: The report directly answers the research query rather than only describing adjacent background.
The report supports central factual claims with identifiable sources or citations.
The report states material limitations, uncertainty, or tradeoffs relevant to the query.
The report is internally coherent and does not contradict itself on core claims.
The report distinguishes evidence from speculation or recommendations.
